text:
anna: Noticed a pattern on small-chat load where p99 jumps when we try to push coalesce up for cost. Thinking about a dynamic affinity layer: instead of global windows, pick per-tenant affinity score and adapt coalesce/window/lease per-score bucket. Thoughts?

ben: Sounds promising. affinity score = recent p95 * request_rate * inverse_kv_hit? How do we avoid oscillation?

carlos: we can smooth the score with an EWMA and add hysteresis on bucket transitions (min dwell 60s). Also separate streaming and request-response flows.

emily: important to consider headroom signals from the worker (gpu_util, inflight_tokens). If worker is near saturation, tighten windows for non-critical tenants aggressively.

deepti: implementation sketch: per-tenant state: {score, bucket, lease_owner, lease_expiry_ms}. Lease semantics: soft-lease (preferred affinity) vs hard-lease (pin until expiry). Soft-lease costs less in kvcache churn.

ben: config prototype: ```
affinity.ewma_alpha=0.2
affinity.buckets=["strict","default","economy"]
affinity.bucket_thresholds={"strict":0.8,"default":0.3}
lease.soft_ms=150
lease.hard_ms=1000
hysteresis.min_dwell_sec=60
```

anna: we need to define clear safety nets: if strict bucket p95 > SLO for 1m, auto-bypass affinity and use per-tenant single-threaded fastpath. Also metric-based abort: worker_kv_miss_rate > 20% for strict tenants -> revert.

carlos: question: when a soft-lease moves a tenant off a worker, should we transfer the KV cache state eagerly or lazily? eager transfer increases latency; lazy risks misses. maybe piggyback cache warming on the first few requests.

emily: also watch for amplification: small tenants grouped into same affinity bucket may form hotspots. we should cap max-tenants-per-worker by bucket.

deepti: for rollout: AB test with three cohorts: 5% strict-affinity (real strict customers), 45% control, 50% economy-affinity. Collect per-tenant p50/p95/p99, avg_batch_size, lease_churn, kvcache.hit_rate, gpu_util, cost_per_token. Run 72h.

ben: metric alerts: if economy token-cost delta > 8% OR strict p95 regress > 10% -> pause rollout. Also add per-worker synthetic probe (50B payload no-kv) every 20s to detect coalesce impact.

anna: good. need to keep the scheduler code path small: decision on bucket should be O(1) and lock-free reads; updates can be batched every 500ms. Avoid per-request complex logic.

carlos: agreed. I'll add a Bloom filter style quick-check for lease ownership to avoid heavyweight map lookups in the hot path.

emily: concern: eviction hysteresis. If we evict due to headroom, prefer soft_eviction tag so the tenant can be reclaimed quickly without full rehydration. Also expose an API to request instant reclaim for developer debug.

deepti: I'll wire dashboards and the AB harness. Suggest adding a tiny tracing span for "affinity-decision" so we can break down latencies attributable to decision vs queueing vs execution.

ann a: typo :) anna: yes on the tracing. also add experiment metadata to logs: cohort=id, bucket, lease_type.

runtime-bot: deploy-bot: experiment ab-1751117777 created and applied to canaries (us-west-2-b).

ben: let's draft a mini-RFC (goal, design, aborts, metrics, rollout) and post it to eng-runtime docs. I'll take cost modeling + worker headroom section.

carlos: I'll write the affinity scoring and lease state machine section. emily: you own the cache/eviction heuristics. deepti: experiment infra and dashboards.

an na: thanks all. aim to have RFC up tomorrow morning.
